name: Loch Ness Monster
description: A large aquatic cryptid said to inhabit Loch Ness, a deep freshwater lake in the Scottish Highlands. The most reported lake monster in the world, with a continuous record of sightings since the 1930s and a distant precursor in the 6th-century Life of St. Columba.

aliases.name: Nessie
aliases.meaning: Affectionate diminutive in widespread use from the 1940s onwards

origin: Reports are confined to Loch Ness in the Scottish Highlands, with a minor secondary tradition (the Morag) in the nearby Loch Morar.
